name: gym-tracker-api

dependencies.name: nutrition-service
dependencies.description: Looks up macros for foods a Trainee searches while logging a meal.

description: The backend API for the gym macro tracker: owns macro targets, food log entries, workout logs, coach invites/links and coach feedback. Persists to its own Postgres database, verifies the gateway's signed assertion for every non-public operation, and calls the nutrition-service for food macro lookups. Does not render any UI and does not itself talk to Thunder except to verify tokens.
